subject: Request: elevated-access justification + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@aurumhealth.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@aurumhealth.com
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: elevated access justification + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC 2/CAIQ

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. As part of Aurum Health's SOC 2 / CAIQ review we're collecting evidence for access control (SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, RBAC and separation-of-duties). Can you please provide the following artifacts by EOD Friday (2027-05-21):

- SAML assertion samples for a successful SSO sign-in (include timestamps and NameID)
- SCIM delta export showing provisioning activity for the last 30 days
- Admin role / privileged user roster with role descriptions (CSV)
- A concise separation-of-duties matrix showing checks for elevated privileges
- Any documented justification for outstanding elevated-access exceptions

For CAIQ correlation: our auditor flagged A2.1 and ID-1.3 — if you can include quick notes mapping artifacts to those control IDs that would be ideal. If anything cannot be exported, let us know what equivalent logs or screenshots will work.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Lead Compliance Analyst
Aurum Health

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evidence request: elevated access justification + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC 2/CAIQ

Irene / Ben — forwarding Aurum's ask. Topline plan: Irene you own producing the SAML and SCIM artifacts, redacting any PII; Ben can you pull the admin roster and the separation-of-duties matrix (SOD) and draft a one-paragraph mapping to the CAIQ/SOC2 questions?

Quick constraints and notes:
- SAML assertions: include 3 samples covering interactive web login, API token exchange (where SAML is used), and an unsuccessful assertion (if available) — scrub any unique IDs that are PHI before sharing.
- SCIM: we have a daily delta log from the provisioning service; please supply a zip with the last 30 days and a short README of how to interpret entries.
- Admin roster: include account creation date, last login, and owner.
- SOD matrix: highlight compensating controls and any approved exceptions with ticket refs.

Deadline internal: can we get a complete draft by Thursday EOD (2027-05-20) so I can review before sending to Aurum Friday morning? If anything is blocked by legal/redaction, flag it in this thread.

Thanks — Rafael
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

From: irene_choi@redwood.com
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: (none)
Date: 2027-05-18T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evidence request: elevated access justification + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC 2/CAIQ

Rafael / Ben — status update and artifact list attached. I pulled samples and packaged them in Drive; attachments here are the local filenames we will include in the delivered bundle:

- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 assertions: web_success, api_success, failed_auth)
- scim_delta_202705.zip (README inside explaining event schema)
- admin_role_roster.csv (columns: account, role, owner, created_at, last_login)
- sod_matrix_v2.xlsx (matrix + exception log with ticket refs)

Notes on redaction: we removed full email addresses when those were PHI-linked, replaced with hashed ids (ex: user:ab12...); timestamps preserved. Service accounts are listed in a separate sheet in the roster and are marked so auditors can filter them out.

I ran a quick sanity check against our provisioning timeline and included a short log extract showing a role assignment flow (scim sample) that demonstrates how role changes are propagated and approved.

If Ben can add the one-paragraph mapping to CAIQ controls and confirm the exception tickets are linked, I can glue the bundle together and share a read-only Drive folder for Aurum.

— Irene
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

(attachment stubs referenced above)
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@aurumhealth.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: elevated access justification + SAML/SCIM artifacts for SOC 2/CAIQ

Hi Samir — thanks for the request and patience. We've prepared the evidence bundle and shared a read-only Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-ExampleDriveLink. Contents (files + short descriptions) are:

- saml_assertion_samples.txt — three redacted assertion examples with short notes (web_success, api_success, failed_assertion)
- scim_delta_202705.zip — 30-day provisioning delta + README (schema and how to read event types)
- admin_role_roster.csv — privileged user roster with last-login and owner fields
- sod_matrix_v2.xlsx — separation-of-duties matrix and exception log (tickets listed)
- readme_mapping.txt — one-page mapping of artifacts to CAIQ/SOC2 questions (A2.1, ID-1.3)

We also linked the internal ticket that documents approved elevated-access exceptions: SEC-482 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-482).

Let us know if the auditor needs additional export formats (CSV/JSON) or a short walkthrough call — we can schedule 30 minutes early next week with Irene. If the Drive link doesn't work for your team, we can also upload to your secure transfer portal.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: saml_assertion_samples.txt (text), scim_delta_202705.zip (zip), admin_role_roster.csv (csv), sod_matrix_v2.xlsx (xlsx)
